title: 通用 Keccak 六输入列奇偶式
scope: Only algebraic theta parity expression; no primitive, state, clock, or scheduling changes
argument: d[x][b] is parity of previous five lanes and next column bit b-1 in both forms; all 32 round-index values retained
expected_benefit: Expose generic LUT5/LUT6 sharing opportunity; actual synthesis decides area and timing
